name: Game On Charters
description: Game On Charters is a Portland fishing business run by local owner and skipper Joe O'Connor, who charters seven days a week when bookings and conditions allow. The boat is a 30 foot Kevlacat with twin 300 hp four-stroke outboards, and trips leave from the ramp beside the Portland Yacht Club at about 7am in winter and 6am in summer, with a 15 to 30 minute run to the grounds. Southern bluefin tuna are the headline target from May to August, and the operator advises booking early for the busy tuna months. Bottom-bouncing for snapper, gummy shark, flathead and nannygai, and deep-drop fishing with Daiwa electric reels to depths of about 700 metres, run all year. Bay and reef charters run five or eight hours and game trips eight to ten hours, for up to six people or eight by arrangement. Shimano and Okuma tackle is supplied, and catches are bled, iced and filleted. BYO food and drinks are welcome.

faqs.q: When can you target bluefin tuna with Game On Charters?
faqs.a: The operator lists bluefin tuna trips from May to August and advises booking as early as possible for the tuna season, which it says runs from about March to July.

faqs.q: Can individuals join a Game On game-fishing trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Individuals and mixed groups can book game-fishing seats at $400 per person on weekdays or $450 on weekends, with at least four people needed; the operator can help make up numbers.
